articles.originalTitle: Hundreds of hidden earthquakes found at Antarctica’s Doomsday Glacier
articles.excerpt: Hundreds of previously overlooked seismic events have been detected beneath Antarctica, including 245 near the marine edge of the Thwaites Glacier. articles.excerpt: There has been some interest recently in determining the longest distance one can sail for on the earth without hitting land, as well as in the converse problem of determining the longest distance one could drive for on the earth without encountering a major body of water.
